project_type: TypeScript pnpm monorepo (Node >=22.14). Autonomous commerce/payments platform: worker drives a durable transaction lifecycle against live Shopify + Razorpay + Supabase Postgres.
build_system: pnpm@9.15.4 workspaces. `pnpm build` runs `tsc -p tsconfig.json` per package (composite projects). apps/worker is a COMPOSITE project: after editing, delete stale tsbuildinfo and dist first (find apps/worker -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -delete; rm -rf apps/worker/dist) then rebuild via `pnpm --filter @counter/worker exec tsc -p tsconfig.json`, else it silently emits nothing.
test_framework: vitest 3.0.7. Integration tests are gated: they read process.env and use describe.skip when creds/DB URLs are absent. real-lifecycle.integration.test.ts gates on SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN + RAZORPAY_KEY_ID. DB integration tests (rls, idempotency-store, policy-store, migrations) gate on TEST_DATABASE_URL.
test_command: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && pnpm test  (baseline: 2764 tests green; 2 worker integration tests skipped without creds). Also pnpm depcruise must pass (2071 modules, 0 violations).
verification_instructions: 1) source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22. 2) pnpm build. 3) pnpm test. 4) pnpm depcruise. 5) Real-infra proofs: export DATABASE_URL / TEST_DATABASE_URL (dedicated throwaway DB or schema), SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN, SHOPIFY_STORE_DOMAIN, SHOPIFY_API_VERSION=2025-07, RAZORPAY_KEY_ID, RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET, then run gated integration tests. 6) scripts/verify-real-transaction.mjs is the reference harness. NOTE: pg module lives at packages/data/node_modules/pg, not repo-root node_modules.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in for these features. tsbuildinfo/dist are gitignored build artifacts. New tables require both NNNN-name.up.sql and .down.sql under packages/data/migrations and a bump to the expected migration version in migration tests.
setup_instructions: git clone present at ~/counterX on branch main (commit 3be05ec). Run `source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22` before every node/pnpm command. Dependencies already installed.
environment_constraints: Network mode OPEN: api.razorpay.com and live Supabase reachable. LIVE Supabase login role is `postgres` with rolbypassrls=TRUE, rolsuper=false — CANNOT be used directly for RLS proofs because ScopedTransactionManager.assertRuntimeRolePosture REQUIRES a restricted (no-bypass, non-super, login, non-inheriting) role. The existing rls.integration.test.ts creates a dedicated restricted role at runtime from the admin connection and drops it in afterAll. WARNING: existing rls.integration.test.ts is DESTRUCTIVE (dropApplicationSchemas drops wallet/merchant/identity/platform CASCADE then re-runs migrations) — meant for a DEDICATED THROWAWAY TEST_DATABASE_URL, NOT the shared live DB with real data. New tenant-isolation tests MUST use throwaway-DB gating and MUST NOT drop the live schema; if only live DB is available they seed/clean ONLY their own rows and create/drop only their own restricted role. secrets:scan uses gitleaks via Docker which may be unavailable; the new secret-leakage scan test must be pure-Node scanning emitted logs/rows/payloads.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT break the existing 2764 tests. Preserve explicit outcomes: never collapse provider errors to try/catch->failed; post-effect timeout is INDETERMINATE. Real-infra tests skip gracefully without creds and MUST clean up (cancel real Shopify orders via orderCancel, delete test DB rows). Never log/commit secrets; read from process.env only. depcruise: shared packages must not import from apps (apps -> packages only). @counter/ui uses Bundler moduleResolution + extensionless imports (do not revert).
key_patterns: PaymentAuthorizationPort (apps/worker/src/transaction-lifecycle.ts) is the money seam; createRealPaymentAuthorizationPort (apps/worker/src/real-lifecycle.ts) drives draft->razorpay->pay->finalize->markPaid->query->reconcile using request.idempotencyKey verbatim for every external effect. Idempotency today: Shopify ActionPorts use IN-MEMORY createIdempotencyStore (packages/shopify-connector/src/order-idempotency.ts) + an in-memory outcomeCache Map in real-lifecycle.ts; Razorpay uses durable server-side X-Razorpay-Idempotency. Durable store EXISTS: runtime.idempotency_keys + PostgresIdempotencyStore (packages/data/src/runtime-repositories.ts) with acquire/complete/fail keyed on (key,digest). Kill switches: KILL_SWITCH_SCOPES = platform|merchant|wallet|agent|mandate|connector|payment_adapter (packages/observability/src/kill-switch.ts) and payment-sdk KillSwitchEvaluator — both IN-MEMORY, no DB table, NOT wired into the worker path. CheckoutOrchestrator (packages/payment-sdk/src/checkout-orchestrator.ts) already enforces mandate/authorization expiry, limits (checkout-limits.ts), policy, kill switches — unit-proven with in-memory doubles. RLS: migration 0003 enables+FORCEs RLS with current_setting('counter.*') claims set by ScopedTransactionManager.establishTransactionClaims. Shopify orderCancel via connector.orderCancel (OrderCancelAction). Gating pattern: const x = process.env['TEST_DATABASE_URL']?.trim() || undefined; const d = x === undefined ? describe.skip : describe;
directory_structure: apps/worker: durable job worker (money seam). packages/data: Postgres repos, migrations, RLS, idempotency store, scoped transactions. packages/observability: kill-switch registry + operator commands. packages/payment-sdk: CheckoutOrchestrator, kill-switch evaluator, checkout-limits, CounterTestPaymentProvider. packages/shopify-connector: Shopify action ports incl orderCancel + in-memory idempotency. packages/razorpay-adapter: real Razorpay provider + durable X-Razorpay-Idempotency. packages/authorization: authorize/mandate/scope/revocation. scripts: verify-real-transaction.mjs (real harness), secrets-scan.mjs.
